text:
Ivy: Hello! First-week Q: where should I post (badge, VPN, laptop issues, repo access), and is there a mentor signup channel? Don't want to flood everything.
IT Help: Welcome Ivy :tada: Quick map: badge -> #people-ops (full name + office), VPN -> #help with 'vpn' in subject, laptop/hardware -> #eng-infra, repo perms -> Access Form (link pinned in #devex) then ping @DevEx if stuck.
Sam D: For team-level onboarding questions (codebase, infra quirks) post in your team channel first and add a short summary for visibility. If it needs infra, create access form and paste the ticket link.
Ivy: Mentor thing? My manager mentioned a mentor sign-up.
Mentors Bot: Mentors sign-up lives in #new-hires-mentors. Use `/mentor signup <your-handle>` to request pairing. Mentors will DM you to schedule a 30m intro. You can also opt-out with `/mentor skip`.
Ivy: Nice. How to silence those dozens of automated reminders?
OnboardBot: Use `/onboard prefs` to open DM toggles, `/onboard pause 7d` to pause for a week, `/onboard stop` to unsubscribe from onboarding DMs.
Rae (People Ops): Badge pickup: if remote and need shipping, DM People Ops with shipping address and start date. Processing ~2 business days.
Leo: Etiquette: use threads, reactions for ack, avoid @channel unless office-wide. For urgent help ping the individual and mark subject URGENT. Large logs -> Gist link + 1-line summary.
Ivy: Super helpful, thank you everyone! I'll join #new-hires-mentors and follow the forms. :wave:
